name: specialized-reviewers
description: Use when a single change genuinely spans several specialty domains at once — security, migrations, concurrency, release — each needing its own dedicated reviewer rather than one generalist's best effort. Implement -> dispatched specialty review panel -> PR. Line count is not the trigger: most work, even large work, is better served by single-reviewer's one reviewer; reach for this only when the domains actually named are plural.

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task; the transition commits its work

stages.name: review
stages.description: Dispatcher selects the specialty reviews this branch needs, fans them out as a joined panel of subtasks, and aggregates their verdicts
stages.prompt: Dispatch the specialty reviews needed for branch $BRANCH against base $BASE_REF, then aggregate their verdicts into one review decision. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT.

stages.name: pr
stages.description: Agent creates a GitHub PR after the specialty panel passes and hands off to the merge master
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the reviewed work on branch $BRANCH.
